title: Western
story: Dusty trails, creaky wagons and a campfire under the stars.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A cowboy hat with a tall creased crown, a wide brim curled up at both sides and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: rich caramel brown with a red band

cards.name: Sheriff Star
cards.subject: A gold five-pointed sheriff star badge with a small ball on each tip and a raised rim along its edges.

cards.name: Harmonica
cards.subject: A harmonica: a long silver rectangle with a row of small square holes along the front, curved cover plates at both ends and two gold screws.

cards.name: Bandana
cards.subject: A bandana: a smooth triangle of cloth with a small knot at the top and a pattern of round dots.
cards.hero_colors: rich red cloth, white dots, small yellow knot

cards.name: Cowboy Boots
cards.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with stitched shafts, pointed toes and a silver spur on each heel.
cards.hero_colors: rich red-brown leather, gold stitching, silver spurs

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A brown leather saddle with a raised horn, a high back, a stitched seat and two stirrups attached to its sides, resting on a wooden fence rail.
cards.hero_colors: rich chestnut brown leather, golden wood fence rail, gold stitching, silver stirrup trim

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A tall green saguaro cactus with two upward arms and ribbed sides, with a flower on top, growing from sand.
cards.hero_colors: rich green with a pink flower

cards.name: Covered Wagon
cards.subject: A covered wagon with an arched white canvas cover on a wooden bed and four wooden wheels, with a wooden tongue at the front resting on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: white canvas, wood brown bed and tongue, red wheel rims

cards.name: Windmill
cards.subject: A farm windmill: a tall tapering four-sided tower with solid walls, a round wheel of many blades at the top, and a tail vane behind the wheel.
cards.hero_colors: rich red-brown tower, white blades, golden yellow tail vane

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it; the logs sit in a ring of grey stones, with a plum enamel coffee pot with a red rim on a flat stone beside it.
cards.hero_colors: orange flames, wood brown logs, plum enamel coffee pot with a red rim, small grey stones
cards.surface_or_setting: a patch of dry dirt with a ring of stones

notes: Composed on 2026-11-08 from the outside rater's best variant (v1) after a review of all three pre-final variants and the producer's earlier grades (experiments/plan_review.py, runs/night/plan_review.json).
Cowboy Hat: the producer's 5 in batch 2; the pre-final hat was graded broken. Source: runs/western-batch2 v1_01.

Sheriff Star replaces the Gold Pan (outside 2): the genre's badge, absent from all three variants. It rose from 2 to 4 with a Blender model; no accent, since a red gem drew a jewel (lessons). Source: runs/western-blockout v1_05.
Harmonica: the producer's 5 in batch 2, with that wording; on v1's pink waves, the set's one pink. Source: runs/western-batch2 v1_03.
Bandana replaces the Barrel (the producer's 1): the producer's 5 in batch 1. Source: runs/western-batch v1_03.
Cowboy Boots: a pair with spurs and no stitched stars, as the producer asked in batch 2 (5); outside 4 on v3's twin. Source: runs/prefinal/western v1_04.
Saddle on a fence rail (v3) instead of on a hay bale (v1), which drew one stirrup and an awkward perch; built objects gained most from blockouts. Source: runs/prefinal/western v3_05.
Cactus: outside 4, the producer's 4, 5 and 5 on earlier wordings. Source: runs/prefinal/western v1_06.
Covered Wagon: outside 3, the producer's 4 and 3; four wheels, tongue on the ground. Source: runs/prefinal/western v1_08.
Windmill with a solid tapering tower (the producer's 4 in batch 1) instead of v1's open truss, which the lessons advise against. Source: runs/western-batch v1_08.
Campfire: the producer's 5 in batch 2, with v1's grey enamel pot instead of a black one. Source: runs/western-batch2 v1_09.

Colors rewritten under the rich-color rule adopted overnight (on the twins, closer to their real cards by CSD on 29 of 40): Cowboy Hat: tan brown with a red band → rich caramel brown with a red band; Bandana: red with white dots and a small yellow knot → rich red cloth, white dots, small yellow knot; Cowboy Boots: leather brown with silver spurs and turquoise stitching → rich red-brown leather, gold stitching, silver spurs; Saddle: leather brown with silver stirrup trim → rich chestnut brown leather, golden wood fence rail, gold stitching, silver stirrup trim; Cactus: green with a pink flower → rich green with a pink flower; Covered Wagon: white canvas, wood brown, red wheel rims → white canvas, wood brown bed and tongue, red wheel rims; Windmill: grey tower and white blades with a red tail vane → rich red-brown tower, white blades, golden yellow tail vane; Campfire: orange flames, wood brown logs, grey enamel coffee pot with a red rim, grey stones → orange flames, wood brown logs, plum enamel coffee pot with a red rim, small grey stones, color words in the subject to match.
Kept by hand: the Sheriff Star stays plain gold (tip colors drew a jewel before), the Harmonica keeps the producer's 5 colors, and the hat and cactus lose invented shading colors.

request.wishes: A set for a Movie collection
